Messages.Author: Fish Flowers
Messages.Body:
Here's a question which came up when discussing possible deck designs last
week -- is there a limit on how much life an Ally may have? Methods of
giving extra lives to Allies are rare, but is sometimes possible
(Nephandus, Shadow Court Satyr, etc) -- can an Ally hold more Lives than
their card indicates?

Fish.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Allies
* There is no limit to an Ally's life (if some effect gives an
Ally more life than it started with, the excess does not drain
off). [TOM 19960604]
